propositions: AcliClient caches both positive and negative JQL search results indefinitely with no TTL or invalidation mechanism, causing stale answers on repeated queries within a client lifetime.
The search memo is intended to scope to one reconcile pass per client instance, but this lifetime invariant is undocumented and unenforced.
Existing call sites (access_check.py and test_reconcile_live_e2e.py) violate encapsulation by directly popping _search_cache to force freshness, causing the negative-to-positive flip bug d30c.
Per-pass client construction ensures binding_recovery's cross-pass miss corroboration uses genuinely fresh queries, not cached negative replays.

The supported fix adds AcliClient.invalidate_search_cache(jql=None) method for per-JQL eviction or full clear, migrates reach-in sites to use the public door, and documents the negative-caching hazard and client lifetime at the cache definition.
